t: When you think small things do not count
a: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
p: Fa-man yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin khayran yarah, wa man yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin sharran yarah.
m: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
